shared_elements: schematic profile figures rendered as simple silhouettes/outlines
row of repeated short strokes forming a band
animal or bird form in profile
multiple figures scattered over an open surface without a frame
justification: The only real correspondences are generic: both surfaces carry small schematic profile figures scattered over an open field, and both include a band of repeated short parallel strokes and a small disc-like element. In content they diverge almost entirely — A is dominated by crewed boats with hull-and-stroke conventions, human figures, a sun-disc on a pole and star/rosette signs, while B shows a stack of quadrupeds and birds in profile plus a row of arcaded loops, with no boats, humans or celestial signs at all.
